top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bond Yields About Fundamentals, Not Bessent, Says HSBC’s Kettner
top_signals.summary: Max Kettner, chief multi-asset strategist at HSBC Bank, points to US growth and exceptionalism as he makes the case for higher US yields. Kettner says, “at the end of the day, this is fundamentals, this is not about what Scott Bessent wants.” He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Itsu blames inflation and Labour tax hikes as rising costs bite
top_signals.summary: Itsu has posted its third consecutive annual loss as the Asian food-to-to chain blamed surging inflation and Labour hikes to employment taxes for its rising costs. The edamame eatery, founded by the grab-and-go tycoon behind Pret a Manger, said the UK’s fast food industry is suffering from fragile consumer confidence and a rising tax burden.  [...]
